description: Helm chart for pr-generator — automated PR creation daemon for Kubernetes. GitHub App/PAT, Bitbucket, multi-provider, ArgoCD annotation discovery, Prometheus metrics.
rules: The chart enforces replicas: 1 — do not increase; the application has no distributed coordination and multiple replicas cause duplicate PR creation
Provider names 'github' and 'bitbucket' auto-infer their type; all other names require an explicit 'type: github' or 'type: bitbucket' field
Each Bitbucket or GitHub PAT provider must use a unique tokenEnv value to avoid credential collisions
config.rules can be empty ([]) when annotationDiscovery.mode is 'annotations_only'; config.rules is required for 'config_only' mode (runtime validation)
Use secrets.github.existingSecret / secrets.bitbucket.existingSecret for production; inline secrets (secrets.github.privateKey etc.) are for dev/test only
serviceAccount.create defaults to true; set to false and provide a name to use an existing ServiceAccount
startupProbe is empty by default (opt-in); enable it when the app needs extra time on first boot to resolve the GitHub App installation ID
The chart version must be bumped on every change to charts/pr-generator/
annotationDiscovery.enabled=true automatically creates a ClusterRole + ClusterRoleBinding and sets automountServiceAccountToken=true on the pod — requires serviceAccount.create=true

annotationDiscovery.mode accepts: 'config_only' (static rules only, default), 'annotations_only' (rules from ArgoCD Application annotations only), 'hybrid' (both sources; annotation destinations take precedence on collision)

Annotation schema uses the annotationDiscovery.annotationPrefix (default: 'pr-generator.io'): pr-generator.io/enabled='true', pr-generator.io/pattern='<regex>', pr-generator.io/destination.<provider-key>='<branch>'
metrics.enabled=true (default) exposes /metrics on the health port (8080) with Prometheus-format counters, histograms, and gauges; disable only if you don't need observability
metrics.serviceMonitor.enabled=true creates a ServiceMonitor CRD — requires Prometheus Operator (kube-prometheus-stack or standalone) to be installed in the cluster
metrics.podAnnotations adds prometheus.io/scrape, prometheus.io/path, prometheus.io/port to the pod spec for scrape without the Operator; set podAnnotations: {} to suppress them
